critical_code_review_comments: storage_key resolution `doc.get('storage_path') or doc.get('filename') or doc.get('storage_key')` is duplicated in both /download and /preview endpoints - extract helper _resolve_storage_key(doc) to DRY.
Preview and download endpoints return raw bytes into memory via FastAPIResponse; for large files use StreamingResponse to avoid memory pressure.
get_object() lets requests raise on non-2xx which surfaces as 500 to client - wrap in try/except and return 502/404 with a friendly message when storage returns 404.
server.py is 4738 lines - split into routers is overdue (mentioned in prior iteration).

Auth: /auth/login role check `if user.get('role') not in ('admin',)` means staff created via /api/staff cannot login via password form. Iteration 8 notes claim staff can login with email/password (first-login modal etc.) - there is a mismatch. Verify intended behavior.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Error cargando preview' is fixed. Both fixes verified: (1) staff role now allowed on /api/company-documents/{id}/preview and /download (test_preview_staff_200 passes with minted JWT), (2) storage_key resolution falls back through storage_path->filename->storage_key and returns 404 when none is set. Frontend Dialog uses iframe for PDFs and img for images. To test staff, mint JWT directly with JWT_SECRET (from backend/.env) since /auth/login rejects non-admin roles.
rca of the issue: Original bug: (1) /company-documents/{id}/preview and /download only allowed roles admin+company, so any staff user got 403 -> frontend shows 'Error cargando preview'. (2) Older documents in db.company_documents used 'storage_key' field instead of 'storage_path'; when only storage_path/filename were checked, empty string was passed to get_object -> upstream 404 -> exception -> 500. Fix (verified): permissions extended to include 'staff'; fallback chain added storage_key; explicit 404 when no key found. Regression tests in test_company_doc_preview.py cover both admin and staff flows and unauth/404 cases.
